しばらく使って良さげなら、もっと改良する

```nnoremap <silent> : :call <SID>exec_command()<CR>

function! s:exec_command() abort
  let in = input(':')
  if empty(in)
    return
  endif
  echom ''
  redraw
  let parts = split(in, ' ')
  let cmd = ''
  if len(parts) == 1
    let cmd = in
  else
    let cmd = parts[0]
  endif

  if cmd[0] is# '!' || cmd[:-1] is# '!' || exists(':' .. cmd)
    exe in
  elseif executable(cmd)
    call s:term_start(in)
  endif
endfunction```
